# Anchor: Tony Hoare. A delayed field-default check sees the bindings at its
# declaration, even if later type specs extend the same local scope.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# All affected types remain unconstructed. Native and ejected checks therefore
# exercise declaration scope without relying on default-application lowering.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^grouped declaration scopes checked$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ../../bad

# An earlier local type shadows the outer constant and cannot be a value.
cp ../cases/earlier.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'C.*is not an expression'
! logos eject -o $WORK/earlier-out
stderr 'C.*is not an expression'

# A later local type is not visible at an earlier default with no outer binding.
cp ../cases/future.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'undefined: Missing'
! logos eject -o $WORK/future-out
stderr 'undefined: Missing'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/defaultgroupscope

go 1.27

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	clock "time"
)

const C = 17
const Key = 17

type Forward struct {
	N int = After
	Opaque map[int]int
}

const After = 17

func laterType() {
	type (
		Cfg struct { N int = C }
		C int
	)
}

func laterAlias() {
	const C = 17
	{
		type (
			Cfg struct { N int = C }
			C = int
		)
	}
}

func laterImportShadow() {
	type (
		Cfg struct { Delay clock.Duration = clock.Second }
		clock int
	)
}

func laterMapKeyShadow() {
	type (
		Cfg struct { Values map[int]int = map[int]int{Key: 1} }
		Key int
	)
}

func earlierType() {
	type (
		Value int
		Cfg struct { N Value = Value(C) }
	)
}

func main() {
	laterType()
	laterAlias()
	laterImportShadow()
	laterMapKeyShadow()
	earlierType()
	fmt.Println("grouped declaration scopes checked")
}

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/invaliddefaultgroupscope

go 1.27

-- cases/earlier.lgo --
package bad

const C = 17

func f() {
	type (
		C int
		Cfg struct { N int = C }
	)
}

-- cases/future.lgo --
package bad

func f() {
	type (
		Cfg struct { N int = Missing }
		Missing int
	)
}
